actorInfo.title: TCGPlayer Listings Scraper — Prices, Sellers & Market Data

readme:
## TCGPlayer Listings Scraper

A scraper for the US trading-card marketplace TCGPlayer that extracts live seller listings and market context for collectible card products (Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana, One Piece, and similar). The Actor reads the public marketplace JSON used by the website (no login or developer API key required) and returns flat, per-seller-listing records containing USD offer price and shipping, condition and printing attributes, available quantity, seller identity and rating, seller program flags, and product-level market statistics (median/market/lowest offers and cheapest-with-shipping). Technical capabilities include paginating every seller offer for a SKU, walking a seller’s shop inventory, performing keyword discovery to find matching SKUs then scraping their listings, optional attachment of recent completed sales for a SKU, deduplication of listings across inputs, and a monitor-style mode that records seen listing IDs so subsequent runs emit only new listings. Keywords: TCGPlayer scraper, listings scraper, seller shop export, SKU restock pricing, marketplace JSON scraping, USD offers, shipping, condition, printing, market stats, seller intelligence, listing monitor, deduplicated listing rows.

## Use cases

- Monitor restock pricing and available conditions for a specific SKU (Pokémon, MTG, etc.).
- Export a seller’s active inventory for shop-level analysis or reporting, with optional per-card filtering.
- Watch for new offers on a product for arbitrage or price-alert workflows (emit only newly-seen listings).
- Keyword-driven discovery: search terms to find products, then collect seller offers and market context.
- Compare US live listing asks with EU or other-market comps by pairing with other marketplace scrapers.
- Build shop intelligence dashboards including seller program flags, public ratings, sales band, and shipping costs.
- Attach recent completed-sales history for SKU-level sales context and comps.

inputSchema.title: TCGPlayer Listings Scraper — product, seller shop, or keyword

searchKeywords.title: Search keywords
searchKeywords.description: TCGPlayer product search queries (e.g. charizard, black lotus). Each keyword finds matching products, then seller listings on those SKUs. Results are merged and deduplicated by listing ID.

sellerNames.title: Seller names
sellerNames.description: Walk each TCGPlayer seller shop (store name as shown on listings, e.g. ProSoul Games). Optional shopQuery keeps only matching card names.

shopQuery.title: Shop name filter
shopQuery.description: When walking seller shops (names or seller URLs), only keep products matching this query. Leave empty for full inventory. Does not apply to marketplace keyword search.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: TCGPlayer product, search, or seller URLs. Product pages scrape seller listings. Search URLs parse q + game. seller= / sellerfeedback URLs walk that shop.

productLine.title: Game / product line
productLine.description: Limit keyword search and seller shops to one TCGPlayer catalog. Ignored when a start URL already includes /search/{line}/product.

printing.title: Printing
printing.description: Keep only this finish (Normal, Holofoil, Reverse Holofoil, …).

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: TCGPlayer sort for keyword search. Product listing tables stay in site price order.

minPrice.title: Min price (USD)
minPrice.description: Drop listings cheaper than this USD amount.

maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)
maxPrice.description: Drop listings more expensive than this USD amount.

listingsPerProduct.title: Max listings per product
listingsPerProduct.description: Cap seller offers fetched per product during keyword search (0 = all listings, subject to maxItems / maxPages). Product URLs always paginate listings. Use 5–10 for cheap discovery; 0 for a full offer book.

includeSalesHistory.title: Include recent sales
includeSalesHistory.description: One extra marketplace call per product for latest completed sales. Adds lastSalePrice / lastSaleDate and a compact recentSales array. Off by default.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum listing rows to collect across all keywords, shops, and URLs. 0 = unlimited (subject to maxPages).

maxPages.title: Max pages per product / shop / search
maxPages.description: Safety cap on pagination. Search returns ~24 products per page; product listings ~20 offers per page.

monitorMode.title: Monitor mode
monitorMode.description: On a schedule, push and charge only listing IDs not seen in a previous run. First run delivers the full match set (baseline). Pair with an Apify Schedule and a stable monitorStoreName.

monitorStoreName.title: Monitor store name
monitorStoreName.description: Named Key-Value store for seen listing IDs across scheduled runs. Use a distinct name per watch (e.g. charizard-nm vs shop-prosoul).

resetMonitorState.title: Reset monitor state
resetMonitorState.description: Clear the seen-ID cache before this run (next run becomes a new baseline).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended on Apify: RESIDENTIAL. Local runs can leave proxy off — marketplace JSON often works directly.
